subject.title: Add bounded PR detail fill command

question: Should Gitcrawl add this first-version `fill-pr-details` top-level command with the proposed flags, ordering, JSON progress, and reserve-rate-limit semantics?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but adding a new CLI command and progress/output contract is a product-surface decision that automation should not finalize without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after rebase and validation
options.body: Resolve current-base conflicts, run focused CLI/store tests, and land the proposed command as the initial supported bounded-fill surface.

options.title: Adjust the command contract first
options.body: Ask for changes to defaults, flags, output fields, or quota policy before merge if maintainers want a different long-term interface.

options.title: Pause bounded fill
options.body: Pause or close this PR if bounded PR-detail fill should wait for a different archive workflow design.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase and validation
recommendation.body: Resolve current-base conflicts, run focused CLI/store tests, and land the proposed command as the initial supported bounded-fill surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest feature-history owner for PR-detail hydration and shared rate-limit behavior.
